bottlenecks.title: Slash handoff is not automatic
bottlenecks.human_cost: Human must invoke /product-spine then separately open /value. Two slash commands before the first product question.
bottlenecks.evidence: spine protocol-0 stops after naming destination; value has its own activation

bottlenecks.title: Missing-session consent tax
bottlenecks.human_cost: After triage to value, human still answers display name + consent before P01.

bottlenecks.title: NotebookLM is outside the Cursor loop
bottlenecks.human_cost: Spine routes to story, but pass-1 recon requires leaving Cursor, uploading sources, pasting a ledger back. Long idle gap with no session.json.

bottlenecks.title: No workproduct trail for story-only path
bottlenecks.human_cost: A repo-claim walk leaves no slug session. Later /product-spine cannot resume; human re-explains context.
bottlenecks.evidence: spine has no session; story forbidden from writing session.json

bottlenecks.title: Slug discovery is silent and easy to miss
bottlenecks.human_cost: Spine rules assume a shared slug, but the human is never shown which slug was derived. Resuming requires remembering the display name or hunting workproduct/.

bottlenecks.title: Human cannot see dual-session state
bottlenecks.human_cost: Spine triage depends on two session.json files and gate atoms. No status strip in product-spine. Human cannot verify why they were sent to lean vs value.

bottlenecks.title: Value gate pass needs a records sidecar
bottlenecks.human_cost: Walk harness could not drive value P12→milestone with answer text alone. Humans hit the same ceremony (decision JSON) when agents forget --records.
bottlenecks.evidence: write_milestone: Module profile has no canonical pass decision

bottlenecks.title: Manual paste across skill boundary
bottlenecks.human_cost: Seven human actions from MS05 focus to accepted atom. Easy to lose the sentence, invent a weaker one, or skip INVEST letters.
bottlenecks.evidence: mvp-scope forbidden auto-accept; tutorial requires paste

bottlenecks.title: Context switch kills coaching continuity
bottlenecks.human_cost: Coaching why/complete_when for MS05 is in lean turn; story skill has its own voice. Human hears two teachers for one sentence.

bottlenecks.title: Spine trusts 'customer clarity enough' on self-report
bottlenecks.human_cost: Human can skip value entirely. Lean C01 still grills segment from scratch. Feels like the spine lied about a shortcut.
bottlenecks.evidence: no-session-mvp rule has no evidence check
